sample_scope_note: A single bounded, polite HTTP request against one representative Community Board's own vote-record/minutes page (no single documented interface exists across NYC's ~59 boards). The page carries dated linked vote-sheet and minutes documents (e.g. 'votereso2026-06.pdf', 'minutes2026-05.pdf'), confirmed present as structural markers; this fixture records reachability and marker presence, not a parsed resolution population.
